name: novel-continuity
description: Extract, validate, query, and diagnose canonical story state with provenance.
procedure: Extract atomic facts and state changes with chapter, scene, and source-span provenance.
Validate time, knowledge, location, possession, injury, relationship, and world-rule changes against current canon.
Persist assigned timeline artifacts with applyArtifactBatch; commit scene-derived canon with provenance.
Commit one idempotent delta or report evidence-backed contradictions; never rewrite prose.
